body:
Root-caused with a real repro (Xvfb + 2.7MB/58k-line construct file + debug arena-block counter): (1) render-highlighted-text re-tokenized the whole file every frame -- windowed to visible lines only. (2) Root cause was actually a shared arena never freeing per-frame render garbage -- added a separate frame_arena reset every frame. Verified: RSS flat at 140900KB over 60s (was 600MB+ climbing before). Full suite + smoke + mingw cross-compile clean. PARENA commit e16076f, CI run 33124654677 green on all 4 jobs.

⚓ ☃
title: Windowed render + per-frame arena — real, measured fix for the large-file crash
